# DisallowWritingIntoStaticProperties

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> 

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `DisallowWritingIntoStaticPropertiesInspection`

Static properties are global mutable state. This opt-in rule flags assignments
to static properties: by default only writes performed outside the class that
declares the property; optionally every write.

## Example

Default option (`ALLOW_WRITE_FROM_SOURCE_CLASS = true`):

```php{19,31,32,40,43}
<?php

namespace Shop;

use Shop\Cache as Store;

class Cache
{
    public static $hits = 0;
    public static $ttl;

    public function touch()
    {
        self::$hits += 1;
        static::$ttl = 30;
        Store::$ttl = 60;

        array_map(function ($v) {
            Cache::$hits = $v;
        }, []);
    }
}

class DiskCache extends Cache
{
    public static $ttl = 5;

    public function reset()
    {
        DiskCache::$ttl = 0;
        parent::$hits = 0;
        DiskCache::$hits = 0;
        Unknown::$whatever = 1;
        Cache::$hits++;
    }
}

function warmUp()
{
    Cache::$ttl = 10;
}

Nowhere::$thing .= 'x';
echo Cache::$hits;
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 19: Modify this static property only from the class that declares it.</li>
<li>line 31: Modify this static property only from the class that declares it.</li>
<li>line 32: Modify this static property only from the class that declares it.</li>
<li>line 40: Modify this static property only from the class that declares it.</li>
<li>line 43: Modify this static property only from the class that declares it.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| ALLOW_WRITE_FROM_SOURCE_CLASS | bool | true | true: only writes from outside the declaring class are reported (D3). false: every static property assignment is reported (D2). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DisallowWritingIntoStaticProperties": {
      "enabled": true,
      "options": {
        "ALLOW_WRITE_FROM_SOURCE_CLASS": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DisallowWritingIntoStaticProperties

/**
 * @noinspection DisallowWritingIntoStaticPropertiesInspection
 */
```
